title: M5 stage 11: explicit signed binomial coefficient evaluation
scope: Section2 coefficient evaluation from sign counts; character/subset count identification is separate

spec.name: M5.Binomial.negative_coeff
spec.statement: ∀ m j : ℕ, (((1 : Polynomial ℤ) - Polynomial.X) ^ m).coeff j = (-1 : ℤ) ^ j * (m.choose j : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Expand (1-X)^m with add_pow after rewriting 1-X=(-X)+1. Like Polynomial.coeff_X_add_C_pow, apply coeff_sum and use (-X)^i=(-1)^i*X^i; only index j contributes. Handle j>m using choose_eq_zero_of_lt. An induction with binomial recursion is also valid. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Binomial.signed_product_split
spec.statement: ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ s ∈ S, f s = 1 ∨ f s = -1) → M5.Binomial.signedProduct S f = (1 - Polynomial.X) ^ M5.Binomial.negativeCount S f * (1 + Polynomial.X) ^ (S.card - M5.Binomial.negativeCount S f)
spec.guidance: Split product with Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not at predicate f s=-1. On negative filter each factor is 1-X; on complement supplied sign hypothesis makes each factor 1+X. Products of constants are powers, and Finset.card_filter_not gives complement count as S.card-negativeCount. Empty S is included. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Binomial.binomial_convolution
spec.statement: ∀ m n k : ℕ, (((1 - Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ m) * (1 + Polynomial.X) ^ n).coeff k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ j * (m.choose j : ℤ) * (n.choose (k-j) : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Use Polynomial.coeff_mul, then Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ. Rewrite coefficients using negative_coeff and Polynomial.coeff_one_add_X_pow. No assumptions k≤m+n: out-of-range chooses vanish automatically. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Binomial.signed_coefficient_eval
spec.statement: ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℤ) (k : ℕ), (∀ s ∈ S, f s = 1 ∨ f s = -1) → (M5.Binomial.signedProduct S f).coeff k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ j * ((M5.Binomial.negativeCount S f).choose j : ℤ) * ((S.card - M5.Binomial.negativeCount S f).choose (k-j) : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Rewrite with accepted signed_product_split then apply binomial_convolution. This is the exact original explicit coefficient formula. Return no enumeration of subsets. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.
